name: Netherlands Geldautomaten (ATMs)
title: Netherlands Geldautomaten (ATMs)
description: Geldautomaten in the Netherlands derived from OpenStreetMap POI exports (EU-POIS/NL, quadkey-tiled). Named features only (amenity=atm), filtered to the European Netherlands bounding box (lat 50.7–53.62, lon 3.3–7.25) to exclude cross-border tile bleed, deduplicated on (name, ~100 m coordinates), coordinates to 6 dp (WGS84), sorted by name. Native Dutch names preserved (ensure_ascii=False).
